people.name: Magog
people.line: A nation that will attack Israel in the future

translations.web: “I will send a fire on Magog, and on those who dwell securely in the islands. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.
translations.bsb: I will send fire on Magog and on those who dwell securely in the coastlands, and they will know that I am the LORD.
translations.kjv: And I will send a fire on Magog, and among them that dwell carelessly in the isles: and they shall know that I am the LORD.
translations.asv: And I will send a fire on Magog, and on them that dwell securely in the isles; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.
